sources.name: GaneshaSpeaks
sources.text: Your senses are likely to remain highly active today. Stay alert and avoid drifting into your own world at the cost of work. It is best for you to keep your eyes and ears open to avoid any misunderstanding with your near and dear ones, suggests Ganesha.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: You might be frustrated by the fact that people are doing things hastily today, Taurus. You might have to accept the fast-paced energy of the day just so you can keep up. Don't worry if you engage in activities that aren't carefully planned beforehand. You will find spontaneous frivolity to be extremely rewarding on a day like this. Expect the unexpected.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: You'll have much nurturing to offer and a clear understanding of who you want to share it with, dearest Taurus. Acts of service will leave a significant impression, and those benefitting from your warmth won't soon forget how supported and taken care of you've made them feel. Family and friends may wish to reciprocate your kindnesses once the Sun, Sagittarius Moon, and Jupiter connect this afternoon. Allow yourself to be pampered by those who are eager to do so.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: Evenings at the movie- theatre or dinner with your spouse seem to keep you in a relaxed and wonderful mood The arrival of money today can relieve you from many financial troubles. Your family would come to your rescue and guide you at the time of crisis. You can learn some lessons by observing others who have mastered a practice. It is extremely helpful in strengthening self-confidence. Natives who are working may have to face several problems at the workplace today. You will unknowingly make mistakes, thereby making you bear the brunt of your seniors. The day is expected to be normal for traders. You can say something unknowingly that can hurt the sentiments of your family members. Regretful over this, you will spend all your time making up for it. Your spouse will push the rewind button of those early stage love and romance today.
